name: earnings-dashboard
description: Privates Dashboard: RevenueCat, AdMob, AdSense, App Store, Google Play, Wise, PayPal – alle Einnahmen in Euro an einer Stelle

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run client"

scripts.app:android: npm --prefix client run sync && npm --prefix client run android
